note: Level 1, both label levels read (.sav copied from the wallace_2026_s2c_desirecert cache; sha256 77e72d25dd6fc1f8800272508884584543e1b81e4b452795fbf26e8c40e4732e verified; the S2c .sps contains no MC text -- its only MC-prefixed line computes MCMcheck from the separate MCMmanip items). CODE DERIVATION: SINGLE spec s2c_mc.csv = (s2c, [(MC{i} -> mc{i}, rev 0) for i in 1..4]): a number-preserving lowercase rename of the source column name (.sav columns 0-based 55-58, between selfcert2 and uncertmind1). No '-' flip prefix, so resp is the deposited value and the live table has no itemcov_recoded column. Exempt from Step 5b (number-preserving rename), no verification files. TEXT: variable labels shipped verbatim except that Qualtrics line-break artifacts ('or\ndoubtful' in MC2, 'certainty\nregarding' in MC3) were replaced by single spaces. No lead-in in any label, instructions left blank. OPTIONS: all seven points value-labelled identically on all four items: 1 Strongly agree, 2 Agree, 3 Somewhat agree, 4 Neither agree nor disagree, 5 Somewhat disagree, 6 Disagree, 7 Strongly disagree; shipped verbatim (every point labelled, nothing padded). INSTRUMENT: the deposit names no scale for these items; the instrument field is an IRW-descriptive label ('Attitude-certainty reflection items') read off the item content, not a published name. MC here is NOT a manipulation check -- the S2c manipulation check is MCMmanip1-4 (in wallace_2026_mcm_check). The dictionary Description 'Unlabeled 4-item check (MC1-4)' is wrong on both counts (items are fully labelled; they are not a check) and should be corrected. Exact-phrase web searches for MC1 and MC3 wording located no published source instrument. DIRECTION: 1 = Strongly agree, so high resp = less reflection on one's own attitude certainty; all four items positively worded, inter-item r 0.57-0.72, all positive; item means sit on the agree side (modal resp 2-3), plausible. COUNTS: source 793 rows, 793 non-missing per item; live 3172 rows = 793 ids x 4; per-item resp-count vectors (1..7) source = live exactly: mc1 79/247/247/91/67/51/11, mc2 59/188/242/107/94/79/24, mc3 85/210/247/100/75/54/22, mc4 79/237/228/113/76/41/19. RIGHTS: no published instrument identified, so no originator page to read and no instrument_rights_register.csv row applies; nothing located reserves a right, silence is permission; no register row written. Wording copied from the study's own .sav labels.
public_note: Responses run 1 = Strongly agree to 7 = Strongly disagree, so a higher value means less agreement; despite the MC item codes these are not manipulation-check items but four statements about reflecting on the certainty of one's own attitudes.
